### How risk-based monitoring redistributes and reshapes capacity planning


As clinical trials grow more complex, effective capacity planning is becoming a strategic differentiator. In BioPharm International, Helen Yeardley discusses how risk-based monitoring models are changing where monitoring effort is directed and what sponsors should consider as they evolve their oversight strategies.
